method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the unemployed individual claiming benefits, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Tex. Lab. Code chs. 201 and 207 as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/tex-lab-code-ch201-general-provisions.txt and tex-lab-code-ch207-benefits.txt (Texas Legislative Council files dated 2026-05-14, retrieved 2026-10-19). The commission's maximum and minimum weekly benefit amounts are inputs.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text under the terms in SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run tx-ui.l4 ; l4 run tx-ui-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Unemployment benefits: weekly benefit amount (s 207.002), partial weeks (ss 201.091, 207.003), maximum benefits (s 207.005), rounding (s 207.006), eligibility (ss 207.021(a), 207.0211), disqualification for how work ended and refusing work (ss 207.044, 207.045, 207.047), severance, workers' compensation and pensions (ss 207.049, 207.050). Out: ch. 208 claims and appeals, training, drug testing, special classes, labor disputes, withholding.
